schedules.name: Lên bài blog và bài mạng xã hội
schedules.text: marketing_plan found work. Follow the marketing-write skill, section "The daily plan": marketing_plan {} returns the brief. If it has a topic, write one article (draft_save, check, schedule). If it has social, write one short post per listed channel from the blog post (kind social, link exactly as given, brief.from = the blog post id), check, schedule. Nobody will answer a question: finish, and end with the one-line result.

schedules.name: Đăng bài đến giờ
schedules.text: marketing_due says something is due or needs a person that you have not raised. Follow the marketing-dispatch skill: claim, publish (lohi-blog for the blog, marketing-browser-post for X, Facebook and Reddit), record, then one report_blocker: due.ask as is.

schedules.name: Đăng bài blog
schedules.text: The blog publish chain stopped on a failed step (its output is attached). If it has an intent_id and the post is not live, call marketing_fail {intent_id, status:"failed", reason}; otherwise do nothing. End with one line.

schedules.name: Kiểm tra đăng nhập mạng xã hội

then.label: Quyết định đã đăng nhập chưa

schedules.text: The sign-in check could not open the browser. If the browser is not installed say so in one line (Nest: Cài trình duyệt); do nothing else.

schedules.name: Báo cáo hằng ngày
schedules.text: marketing_report gave the daily report lines. Answer with those lines as they are, in plain Vietnamese, nothing added; no tool calls.

schedules.name: Kênh mạng xã hội

rules.support_reply: Bạn nhắn Hỗ trợ trong app Lohi nhé
Bạn nhắn Hỗ trợ trong app Lohi nhé
Please message Support in the Lohi app.

schedules.text: Create X, Facebook and Reddit channels the first time (paused until the founder signs in) and fill unset caps. It never unpauses a channel or overwrites an edit; nothing for a model to do.

schedules.name: Đọc phản hồi
schedules.text: marketing_replies_sync found replies to classify or a channel to read. Follow the marketing-replies skill: read in the browser, classify, marketing_reply_save, answer only safe ones through check and schedule, raise the rest.

schedules.name: Đọc Search Console
schedules.text: Read yesterday's Search Console numbers for the published posts. A revoked sign-in is raised by the host as one Cần bạn item; nothing for a model to do.

schedules.name: Đọc số chiến dịch
schedules.text: marketing_campaign_report read the Lohi api for the running campaigns. Follow the marketing-measure skill, section Campaigns: record each outcomes item with the host outcome tool as given, update tokens_used for each tokens_due id, and tell the founder each tell item once.

schedules.name: Kiểm tra điều kiện đăng blog
schedules.text: lohi-blog_ready found a prerequisite of publishing the blog that is missing. File its ask as one Cần bạn item with report_blocker (summary, missing, options as given) and end the turn.

schedules.name: Đọc bảng số sản phẩm
schedules.text: company-loop_scoreboard_sync could not read the product scoreboard. If its answer has an ask, file it as one Cần bạn item with report_blocker (summary, missing, options as given) and end the turn; otherwise say its message in one line.

schedules.name: Bản tin cơ hội hằng tuần
schedules.text: Weekly digest. Follow the company-digest skill: company-loop_signals {} gives the packet, rank at most five opportunities (content or product), company-loop_digest_save them, record its outcomes, file its ask with report_blocker, end in one line. If a step failed (its output is attached), say the plain line in one sentence and stop.

schedules.name: Theo dõi đội dựng
schedules.text: company-loop_team_watch found a requirement released. Record each item of outcomes with the host outcome tool exactly as given, then end with one line. Do nothing else.

schedules.name: Chấm kết quả quyết định
schedules.text: Fills actual_delta of decisions past check_after_days from the scoreboard and keeps the hit rate for the Công ty page; nothing for a model to do.
